name: @luoshuizhiwei/dsh-desktop-restart
description: DeepSeek Harness desktop restart plugin: five entries (sidebar panel / sidebar footer / conversation header / slash command / settings row) restart the whole Electron app through a detached helper; restarts are hard-blocked while a plugin install/update is running; also sweeps DSH's leftover temp snapshots and hides the easy-to-misclick Feedback item. UI text follows the app's language (zh/en). 桌面版重启插件：五个入口一键重启整个 Electron 应用；插件安装/更新中硬拦重启；顺手清理 Temp 遗留快照、藏掉易误点的「意见反馈」；界面文案跟随主应用语言（中/英）。
author: luoshuizhiwei
